properties.site-address: St Johns Roman Catholic School, Lisburn Terrace, Alnwick (brownfield parcel)
properties.notes: Former school site that is mainly brownfield in nature. Residential scheme now under-construction (16/02211/FUL.) To date, 12 units completed in 2018/19 with remaining 12 forecast for completion in 2019/20. This revised scheme replaced a previous permission for 29 dwellings (A/2009/0034). The original permission(s) relate to Site 0382 - over half of the of site is brownfield land (0.49ha) - indicative yield of around 17 dwellings can be calculated based on methodological approach. The original SHLAA site (ref 0382) is split to reflect brownfield and greenfield elements - total area of 0.86ha. Revised proposal relates to Site 8081 (greenfield). The former is majority brownfield whereas the latter is greenfield.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
